notes.title: Update #1.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884862/5f524de048bc76b635fd30a1c3703cd2395f549f.png[/img]

1. Improved the ability to complete the game for players with processors that do not support the necessary instructions for AI in button mode.
2. The maximum number of saves from which overwriting of previous ones begins has been increased to 30.
3. The display of save time in Russian has been changed.
4. Fixed a situation where the save could be damaged after interacting with a box of potatoes.
5. FIxes in the download system.
6. Bugs in some autosaves have been fixed.
7. Added a tooltip for the lantern.
8. Fixed some items in the village that were hanging in the air.
9. Removed the dot in the center of the screen in some titles.
10. Changed a number of sounds to improve the gaming experience.
11. Removed the ability to interact with a number of items before this is possible in terms of gameplay.
12. Bugs with camera visual effects have been fixed.
13. Fixed the ability to pick up more key items than needed.
14. Improved lighting and shadow rendering.
15. Improved texture streaming algorithm.
16. Fixed bugs with the display of some textures.
17. Fixed and improved several jump scares.
18. Added voice overs for the MPC at some points in the game.
19. Improved visibility of the icon above the 'miracle grass.'
20. Fixed a bug when the player saw a notification about adding non-existent tasks.
21. Improved map performance.
22. Fixed some bugs that made it impossible to progress through the game without loading the last save.
23. Improved interaction for some items in the scene.
24. Some other minor bug fixes.
